from_source.notes: Without X11 and Wayland the only Linux video drivers are offscreen and dummy, which is enough for headless smoke runs and probes.

allocation.hook: SDL_SetMemoryFunctions(SDL_malloc_func, SDL_calloc_func, SDL_realloc_func, SDL_free_func); returns bool. Signatures: void*(size_t); void*(size_t nmemb, size_t size); void*(void* mem, size_t size); void(void* mem). Calling convention SDLCALL. No aligned hook.
allocation.install_constraint: Must be the first call into SDL: 'unsafe once anything is allocated'.
allocation.pre_install_check: SDL_GetNumAllocations() returns outstanding allocations, or -1 when allocation counting is disabled; it must not be positive at install time.

diagnostics.log_hook: SDL_SetLogOutputFunction(SDL_LogOutputFunction, void* userdata); callback void SDLCALL(void* userdata, int category, SDL_LogPriority priority, const char* message).
diagnostics.assert_hook: Runtime: SDL_SetAssertionHandler(SDL_AssertionHandler, void* userdata); handler returns SDL_AssertState from const SDL_AssertData*.

build_flags.self_check: SDL_GetVersion() at runtime; stable releases have an even minor version (SDL_VERSIONNUM_MINOR).

platform.gpu_shader_formats: SDL_CreateGPUDevice takes a mask of formats the app can supply; each backend accepts only its own (SPIR-V for Vulkan). Query SDL_GetGPUShaderFormats.
